objective.name: sandbox.remote.echo
objective.description: Wrapper outbound call toward a remote wrapper-backed capacity

#root.role: Emit an outbound cross-instance wrapper call and return the remote echo payload.

effects.external_route: The wrapper emits an outbound cross-instance capacity call.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a remote wrapper-backed response returned through the inter-instance path.
invariants: The wrapper emits exactly one outbound sandbox.echo user call to the requested remote context.
The returned payload reflects remote response metadata instead of flattening the remote payload into local fields.
ok is hard-coded to true by the wrapper when the outbound call itself returns.
success: On success, sandbox.remote.echo returns ok, remote_status, remote_from, and remote_payload.
remote_payload contains the payload returned by the remote wrapper-backed sandbox.echo capacity.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound inter-instance emit_and_wait call cannot complete.
Missing message is normalized to an empty string instead of causing a contract failure.
notes: This is a wrapper-side remote-call oracle used in inter-instance tests.
The contract intentionally exposes the remote response envelope to test routing fidelity.
